text: A fibre route between two cities is 6,600 km. Using a propagation velocity of 204 km/ms, what is the minimum possible round-trip time, before any equipment does anything?
explanation: One way is 6,600 / 204 = 32.4 ms; a round trip is twice that, about 65 ms. Choosing 32 ms confuses one-way with round-trip delay — the single most common error in this calculation. No amount of money reduces this figure; it is set by the refractive index of glass.
